sections.title: Everything from this unit, in one recipe
sections.content: Making gulyás from start to finish chains together what you already know from this unit: hozzávaló/recept/fűszer, -val/-vel for tools and ingredients, and the imperative for each step.

items.spanish: Vágd fel a hagymát és a fokhagymát késsel.
items.english: Cut up the onion and the garlic with a knife.

items.spanish: Tedd a fazékba, és forrald vízzel.
items.english: Put it in the pot, and boil it with water.

sections.content: This is the same kind of sentence-chaining you already used for a friendship in Unit 5 and a family recipe in daily life — one grammar point at a time, now working together on one real dish.
